name: Ho Won Lee
title: Professor

education.thesis: Prediction of Microstructure by Multi-scale Modeling of Recrystallization based on Cellular Automata and Finite Element Method

Research Interests.category: Computational Mechanics and Metal Forming Process Simulation
items: Finite Element Analysis and Process/Die Design of Metal Forming (Rolling, Forging, Extrusion, Wire Drawing, Sheet Stamping)
Constitutive Modeling of Hot Deformation: Flow Stress, Processing Maps and Surface Defect Prediction
Sheet Metal Formability and Ductile Fracture: Forming Limit Diagrams, Fracture Loci and Damage Mechanics
Tribology in Metal Forming and Micro/Nano Surface Patterning (Friction Testing, Roll-to-Roll Hot Imprinting)

Research Interests.category: Multi-scale Modeling of Microstructure and Mechanical Behavior
items: Crystal Plasticity Finite Element Modeling of Texture Evolution, Formability and Micromechanical Heterogeneity
Microstructure Evolution Modeling: Recrystallization, Grain Growth and Solidification (Cellular Automata, LBM–CA)
Multiscale Mechanical Characterization: Nanoindentation–FE Inverse Analysis, In-situ EBSD/Neutron Diffraction, Acoustic Emission
Additive Manufacturing: Process–Microstructure–Property Relationships, Residual Stress and Architected Metamaterials
Energy-Beam and Thermal Processing: Laser/Electron-Beam Melting, Large Pulsed Electron Beam Surface Treatment, Heat Treatment–Microstructure–Property Linkages
Deep Learning-based Property Prediction and Process Optimization
Physics-Informed Machine Learning and Surrogate Models for Manufacturing Processes and Polycrystal Plasticity
Generative AI for Microstructure Synthesis and Inverse Design (Diffusion Models, GANs)
Materials and Manufacturing-Specialized VLMs, AI Agents and Autonomous Laboratories
